component.name: CodeSnippet
component.description: Syntax-highlighted code display with copy functionality, line numbers, and language detection.

parts.label: toolbar
parts.description: Top bar showing language label and copy buttons (single/multi variants only).

parts.label: copy button
parts.description: Copies code to clipboard (single variant: Button, multi variant: SplitButton with copy options).

parts.label: expand/collapse control
parts.description: Show more/less button when maxLines exceeded.

constraints: Inline variant renders as inline code (no toolbar, no line numbers).
Single/multi variants render as block-level figures.
MaxLines truncates content with expand control.

behavior.map: Displays syntax-highlighted code using Prism.js. Supports 10 languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, XML, Python, Go, Rust, JSON, Bash, Markdown). Three variants: inline (clickable code), single (copy button), multi (split button with copy options). Optional line numbers. Copy button copies raw code or code without comments (multi variant). Toast notification confirms copy success/error. Expand control shows hidden lines when maxLines exceeded.
behavior.rendering: Inline variant renders as <code>. Single/multi variants render as <figure> with <pre><code>. Line numbers render if showLineNumbers=true and variant != inline. Expand control renders if maxLines exceeded.
behavior.defaultState: Code displayed with syntax highlighting. Copy idle. Not expanded.

logic.effect: Copies raw code to clipboard. Shows toast. Sets copyState to 'copied'.
Copies raw code to clipboard. Shows toast.
Strips comments from code, copies to clipboard. Shows toast.
Copies code to clipboard. Shows toast.
Toggles isExpanded state. Shows full code or truncated code.

feedback.hover: Inline code: cursor pointer if allowCopy=true. Buttons: inherited from Button component.
feedback.focus: Inline code: focus ring if allowCopy=true. Buttons: inherited from Button component.

states.default: Code displayed, copy idle, not expanded.
states.copied: Code copied to clipboard, toast shows success message.
states.error: Copy failed, toast shows error message.
states.collapsed: Truncated code visible (if maxLines exceeded and not expanded).

layout: Inline variant cannot have line numbers or toolbar.
MaxLines only applies to multi variant.
Line numbers auto-hidden on inline variant.
content: Language must be one of 10 supported languages.
MaxLines must be positive integer if provided.
nesting: Inline variant can be nested in text content (inline-level).
Single/multi variants are block-level (cannot nest in inline content).

aria.codeBlock: aria-label="Code snippet in {language}" or custom via aria-label prop.

accessibility.keyboard: Inline code: Enter/Space to copy (if allowCopy=true). Buttons: inherited from Button component.
accessibility.focus: Inline code: tabIndex=0 if allowCopy=true. Buttons: focusable.
accessibility.contrast: Code text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum). Syntax highlighting maintains sufficient contrast.

responsiveness.rules: Code wraps on narrow screens. Toolbar stacks if insufficient width. Line numbers remain visible on all screen sizes (if enabled).

usageNotes: Use inline variant for short code snippets within text (e.g., variable names, function calls).
Use single variant for simple code blocks with copy functionality.
Use multi variant for longer code blocks with copy options (raw or without comments).
Supported languages: javascript, typescript, html, xml, python, go, rust, json, bash, markdown.
Line numbers enabled by default (can disable via showLineNumbers=false).
Copy functionality enabled by default (can disable via allowCopy=false).
MaxLines truncates content and adds Show more/less button (multi variant only).
Prism.js used for syntax highlighting (loaded at component level).
Inline variant clickable if allowCopy=true (role=button, tabIndex=0).
Comment stripping regex removes line comments (//) and block comments (/* */).
aria-label can be customized via aria-label prop.
